Mum and Dad reassure the girls but when they wake up to no chocolate eggs, Bingo fears the worst. Luckily Bluey finds a series of clues and a treasure hunt throughout the house begins.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Poop
programme.desc: Jen is studying the poop of different dinosaurs on the island, so Andy heads out on an epic adventure to collect some samples. Along the way, he meets an Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Bubbles
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun blowing and popping bubbles. In the Cloud Kitchen, all the bubbles give Patch an idea for a tasty treat - blast off melon rockets!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Gliding, Argentina
programme.desc: The Go Jet cadets are taking to the skies in Argentina in an attempt to pass their academy gliding test. As gliders do not have engines, Xuli is teaching two other pilot cadets how to glide using thermals to keep them up in the air. Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Valley Of The Balls, Kazakhstan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to the Valley of Balls in Kazakhstan, where they find thousands of rocks which are almost perfectly round. Meanwhile, Grandmaster Glitch is seeking the ideal ball to use to practise his bowling - something big and heavy. What could be better then one of the giant balls of rock from the Valley of Balls? But things start to go wrong for the Grandmaster when he rolls the ball of rock right out of Grim HQ and straight towards an unsuspecting group of tourists. The Go Jetters ta

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S24 - Thomas' Fuzzy Friend
programme.desc: Thomas befriends a stray dog who is wandering around the railway and tries to find him a home. In the process, Thomas derails and the fuzzy little dog raises the alarm.

programme.title: Nikhil &amp; Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Monster Camp
programme.desc: When Jay discovers Nikhil had camped in the wild, he wants to have a monster camping adventure in their garden. Will they meet any monsters? And will Jay be as brave as Nikhil?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bug Hotel
programme.desc: Benjamin and Sophie have a new bug friend. Stanley helps build a bug feeder which attracts lots more bugs. They eat so much; Stanley gets more food and builds a Bug Hotel for them.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Recycling
programme.desc: Fred, Fifi and Ari call Stanley to help them with their recycling drive by coming up with a way of repurposing all the towns' old stuff. Stanley makes a crazy golf course!

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Like Tractors
programme.desc: From riding cows to having pigs in the house, the funny animals chat about everything brilliant about farms.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran S01 - It's time for a birthday party
programme.desc: When JoJo learns that Jared was too busy to have a birthday party, Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan to throw Jared a surprise belated birthday party!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Shopping
programme.desc: Maisy goes shopping for groceries, but forgets what was on her shopping list.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Ambulance
programme.desc: Maisy and Charley help Eddie in their ambulance.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Carrot
programme.desc: Carrot sings about being trendy.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Carrot the Champion
programme.desc: Evil Pea captures Supertato, but Carrot masters the ultimate flip kick and rescues her.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Wonder Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea tricks Supertato by pretending to be his sidekick and captures him instead.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Crazy Golf
programme.desc: Laa‐Laa shows Tinky Winky how to play crazy golf. Tinky Winky loves hitting the ball which travels up and down the hills of Teletubbyland and in to the Tiddlytubbies.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Gloves
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'gloves' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different types of gloves - green gloves, gold gloves, woolly gloves, fingerless gloves and glowing gloves.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Felix Finds His Voice
programme.desc: Messy the monster hears a chirping bird outside his window, but he can't understand what the bird is saying.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Pizzas Away
programme.desc: Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

Glitch visits their camp and inadvertently offends them, then his misfiring jetpack causes him to land on one of their precious horses, causing it to gallop away from the camp with Glitch on its back!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Thomas and the Forest Engines
programme.desc: In Brazil, Thomas meets two wood-burning engines who've never travelled beyond their eucalyptus railway.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Alien Elephant﻿
programme.desc: When Nikhil and Jay find a tiny elephant, they have very different ideas about what to do with it. Jay wants to play alien spaceships with the elephant, but Nikhil wants to display it in his museum.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Detective
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to help solve the mystery of the Phantom Knitter. Overhearing this, Fifi jumps at the chance to help forming a dynamic, detective duo!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - First Aid
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to see if she can practice her first aid skills on him, but he's all fit and healthy. Instead, they go about the town making good use of Myrtle's newfound abilities.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - No Kissing In School
programme.desc: From feeling nervous and shy, to making a million friends! The funny animals chat about all the things they love about school.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time for Halloween
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are getting ready for a Halloween party, but when JoJo accidentally squashes their spooky pumpkin lantern, they need a replacement! Luckily Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.desc: Maisy goes to Kiki's house to play with some kittens, and one wants to come home with her!

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Not So Supertato

programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'scooter' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different scooters - a purple scooter, a blue scooter and a bopping scooter.

programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need to move a crashed meteor. But every time Mojo goes near the big rock, moving turns to grooving. How can you move a meteor if you can't stop dancing?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together

programme.desc: In order to help protect a sandcastle that he and Tala built, Glitch uses a giant vacuum to suck up the sand from the Academy's beach, exposing the illusive ghost crabs to the hungry seagulls up above. To make matters worse, Glitch and his Grimbots lose control of the vacuum, causing chaos in the ocean. Can the Go Jetters protect the crabs while also returning the sand to its proper place?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Copycat
programme.desc: Bluey's having fun copying everything Dad says and does, but the game takes a serious turn when Bluey finds a hurt budgie and they have to make an emergency trip to the vet.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Hammerbarn
programme.desc: On a trip to Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo create their own mini-homes side-by-side in the trolley. But Bluey quickly gets jealous of her neighbour, Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Hungry Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Andy and Jen are throwing themselves a party to celebrate an epic year on Dino Island but discover that their prehistoric pals have been helping themselves to all the party food.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Boots
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit Patch in the Cloud Kitchen, but he has lost one of his boots - it was stolen by a cheeky crab. This gives him a great idea for a tasty treat - crabby croissant.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Going Slow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are rushing around, so Duggee shows them how to enjoy things at a slower pace. However, they come across Tortoise who needs to get to the hospital as his wife is having babies. Duggee and the Squirrels need to get him there fast!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Memory Badge
programme.desc: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he's lost it! He's having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out. The squirrels start to look for it but they can't find the tooth anywhere. Time to think carefully and remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Compass Navigators
programme.desc: Kyan and Foz are working on their compass navigation skills and need to find the North Tower within a magnificent maze in order to pass their academy test. Grandmaster Glitch also tries to join in the amazing maze action but ends up getting lost. In a fit of frustration, he glitches the maze by bulldozing through the hedges with his Grim-mower. The Grim-mower dives into the ground, causing the pathways to crack. Foz falls into one of the cracks and needs to be rescued.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the war's front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert history's tragedy.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Christmas Surprise

Determined to win this kid over, Tina ends up going rogue as a trike hoodlum, and her own field team is forced to reign her in.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Rough Ride

programme.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - Cult Fiction

programme.desc: King Julien and Maurice infiltrate a Foosa gladiator school; Sage and Clover must face their enemies; Mort decides he must form his own army

programme.desc: When Lotta goes to the Crush 4U concert, she gets a chance to meet the band but makes a bad first impression and goes through great lengths for a second chance.

programme.desc: Frufru declares that she doesn't believe in climate change and Dot sets out to change her mind. Lotta discovers the popularity of Melvin's video channel and starts a rival channel.

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Scraptool Apprentice
programme.desc: After Skrap-It's plan to please D-Structs and D-Stroy goes wrong, the Trux have to deal with a bunch of supercharged Scraptools.

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Silent Trux
programme.desc: The Trux eat some tainted ore that makes them lose their voices, then have to race against D-Structs and D-Stroy to find the remedy.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S3 - The Moving Finger Writes
programme.desc: Puss and the gang attempt to find Sino for help to stop the earthquakes and end up on a dangerous journey to “The Forbidden Citadel”

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S3 - And, Having Writ, Moves On
programme.desc: The real Sino is revealed, and Puss finds out that the only way to undo the events leading to the end of the World is to go back to before he entered San Lorenzo

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Catch Me If You Sam Toy Driver
programme.desc: It’s Tag and Scooch’s first day of Race Cadets and Sam Whippet tells the Cadets that whoever can catch him in a race will be the new team captain. \ When Mom donates a box of Tag’s old toys to the new daycare center, Tag decides that the only way to get her box of toys back is to go around town collecting toys to swap out for her toys.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Power Outage Part 3 + 4
programme.desc: Power Outage – Part 3: Escape from Scare School Things worsen when a leprechaun, Razznik, steals the magical cleptor that now holds all of Scare School's powers. Power Outage – Part 4: The Final Battle On a hunt for ghostly powers, the evil leprechaun orders Deedstown to hand over Casper's uncles, OR ELSE.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Ghost In The Gallery Wart On The Nose
programme.desc: Ghost in the Gallery After hearing reports of a ghost stealing artwork from the Deedstown Museum, Casper becomes convinced that his uncles are involved. Wart on the Nose When Professor Thurdigree Burns comes down with dragon flu, Casper, Mantha and Ra are tasked with finding a cure.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - You (Don't) Snooze, You Lose Save The Squasher
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isn't always the best approach. When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Gopher it! A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Tea Party
programme.desc: When Olivia’s Mom gets sick, Olivia steps into her shoes and helps plan a tea party. And not just any old tea party – this is a pirate tea party! It’s not quite what the client had in mind, but in the end they have to admit: there’s never been a tea party as much fun as Olivia’s!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Tip Top Tapper
programme.desc: Olivia is disappointed when she hurts her leg on the eve of her big tap dance recital. But the show must go on! Taking inspiration from her baby brother William’s rolling walker, she builds herself a fanciful apparatus – the tip top tapper – so that she can dance as scheduled. Thanks to her new invention, her performance is a hit!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Firefighter
programme.desc: A firefighter’s visit to Olivia’s classroom inspires Olivia and her friends to become make-believe firefighters themselves. Their first mission: to get Olivia’s cat Edwin into a tree, so they can rescue him. But their plan works a little too well: before long, every cat in the neighborhood is stuck in the tree!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Best Gift Ever
programme.desc: Olivia’s baby brother William’s first birthday is coming up and Olivia is determined to find him the absolute best gift ever. But what does he want? After much sleuthing, she makes him a homemade xylophone… only to discover he likes the wrapping paper best of all.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Monster Movie Quacky Duck
programme.desc: Monster Movie – Casper and Jimmy want to enter the Deedstown Horror Movie festival by making their own scary movie – after all, who better to make a monster movie then real monsters? When Thatch destroys the master copy the little monsters hopes are dashed – until clever Casper realises that real monsters can still present a movie, in REAL 3D Quacky Duck – A cute little plastic bath duck finds it way into Scare School. Everyone is horrified, it’s FAR too cute! Whoever’s brought it to school must

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Dopplegangers Totally Bats!
programme.desc: Dopplegangers – The little monsters are excited because the headmasters have given them a special zapppy control device which can make them transform into anything. They demonstrate it by turning themselves into each other. Cool! Say the kids. Casper heads straight to Jimmy’s in order to play a trick on his friend but it goes badly wrong when Graham thinks Casper really IS his son Jimmy and takes him off to a TV show where Jimmy’s supposed to on a Quiz. Jimmy’s expert topic is ‘computers’ – Casp

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lola's nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas' diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spinny Water Kelp's Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s “fun-crastinating” puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - King Burple
programme.desc: After Burple and Cutter crash-land in a village of tiny dragons, Burple's unintentional act of courage leads the locals to crown him as their king.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Charged Up
programme.desc: Magnus's superpowered mechano-dragon threatens to replace the Riders. But when it spirals out of control, the town's real heroes have to step up!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - CatRat The Bandit
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Frog-let Tale
programme.desc: Lala, who's grown into a froglet, is ready to finally join the gang on a big adventure in the city! But she relies on her water bowl to get around, and Gloria goes overboard in trying to protect her tiny friend in the big world- only to realize that she underestimated all Lala is capable of doing.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Snow Day
programme.desc: When a snowstorm blocks Kate from accessing the zoo, Melman decides to become “substitute Kate” and make sure the animals are cared for. But when the animals go wild in the snow, Melman’s future-paramedic skills are put to the test during an outbreak of stubbed toes and boo-boos. A series of stumbles makes Melman question whether he’s cut out to be a paramedic--until he learns that mastering a goal takes grit!

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - King of Camp Dancing Disco Zombies
programme.desc: Archibald goes to camp and discovers his bunkmate is molting! Archibald helps his new friend find his groove and still have a good time at camp. When Archibald accidentally creates the catchiest disco melody ever made, the whole town cannot stop dancing.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - The Time Disruptor
programme.desc: Archibald accidentally uses Loy’s time travel device, embarking on an adventure through past, present and future. But when the device breaks, he’ll need to find a way to get back home without disrupting the space-time continuum. When Archibald returns from his journey through time he’s heartbroken to learn that he’s no longer the wearer of his beloved sweater. Now, he must travel back through time to correct his mistake before he loses his identity forever.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Amazamoose and Squirrel Wonder: Chapter Two
programme.desc: When a mysterious goop gives Fearless Leader real life superpowers, Rocky and Bullwinkle must reprise their masked hero personas.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Amazamoose and Squirrel Wonder: Chapter Three
programme.desc: The mystery goop strikes again when Rocky’s stress ball falls into a vat of goop, making it sentient and gigantic! Now the stress ball is bouncing through New York City, getting bigger and bigger.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - The King Who Would Be King
programme.desc: Fred the Giant Scorpion vows revenge after he reads an untrue story about himself in King Julien's new book.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Are You There Frank? It's Me, King Julien
programme.desc: Frank the Sky God comes to the lemur kingdom to prove his existence – and to demand the ultimate sacrifice: King Julien himself.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Nuttypunny Jealohsy
programme.desc: When Tip can't win at the Boov game of Nuttypunny, her identity is challenged; Oh tries to win back Krunkle's affection with misguided help from Tip.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Breakers A Day Without Tech
programme.desc: To save their family vacation, the Tucci's must “out-party” the hard-partying Breakers; When Boov-tech stops working, Oh goes off the grid.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - A Teacup Filled with the Self
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Alphabout
programme.desc: Trained by her parents, Eep competes in Alphafight-- a tournament where the animal kingdom fights to determine the dominant species. But when Eep learns that a human winning could upset the balance of nature, she must choose between winning to make her parents proud, and losing to protect the other animals.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Bad Luck Moon Rising
programme.desc: "Phil and Guy try to disprove the Croods' belief that leaving offerings to the fire moon will prevent bad luck. But when their efforts seem to cause a series of mishaps, they'll have to retrieve the horn of a dangerous ramaconda to turn their luck around."

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Beardfoot
programme.desc: Upset that he can't grow a beard, Grug resorts to some unorthodox hair growth methods. But when Phil's experimental hair formula makes fur grow all over Grug's body, he flees to the woods to avoid the other farm residents' attempts to shave him.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Meltdown
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Hollywood Beginning
programme.desc: Three months after their battle in the arctic, the team is back in L.A. with one major change: they’ve been fired as Spy Racers! Most of the team is able to easily readjust to civilian life: Frostee is trying to get his license and Layla is a professional stunt driver in the biggest movie franchise in the world. But Tony can’t rest; his gut is telling him that Dann is still out there and is plotting to destroy L.A. and he’ll stop at nothing to prove it.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Dann Hunt
programme.desc: Tony was right; Dann is back and she’s been spotted all around Los Angeles! The Spy Racers get back together on an unofficial mission to bring her down! Meanwhile, Ms. Nowhere, Palindrome and Roscoe run their out bounty hunter operation.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Stryke Out
programme.desc: Hiccup and Toothless are captured and must find a way to escape the Dragon Fighting arena and survive an attack from the fearsome Triple Stryke dragon.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Tone Death
programme.desc: After the Riders save a Deathsong egg from the Dragon Hunters, they must take it back to Melody Island when the hatched baby won't stop crying.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Between A Rock And A Hard Place
programme.desc: When Hiccup and the Riders discover that Viggo is using two captured Catastrophic Quakens to build a dragon prison, they must help the dragons escape.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Trading Up
programme.desc: Boss takes an overdue vacation day, and ends up teaching Tabitha the value of "trading up" valueless objects into something she actually wants, an electric scooter. programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1873集

programme.desc: 最有趣的學校課程單元探索台灣最酷特色小學， 認識不一樣的學校課程。發掘全台各小學充滿魅力且迷人的特色教學孩子化身為小老師、小職人、小導覽員，分享感受、展現自信與活力主持人沉浸式體驗校園酷趣事及不同面向學習環境，了解在地特色民情透過鏡頭，一起跟著孩子們探索台灣的多元文化吧！

programme.title: 生活智多星第1873集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第349集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 因為堅持第4集
programme.desc: 在米粒上刻字，在裁縫針上刻字，在頭髮上寫字，毫芒雕刻家陳逢顯在微雕方寸間不斷鑽研，創造無數奇蹟。

programme.title: 做陣來舞弄第3集
programme.desc: 拍攝團隊花費多年跑遍全臺各大小廟宇，發現臺灣廟宇可見面向相當廣泛，不僅是民眾的信仰中心，還兼具民俗技藝、休閒、藝術…等功能，透過影片可以看見信徒對神明的感恩之心、祭典慶典時熱鬧的陣頭凝聚了當地的力量。

programme.title: 生活快易通第230集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的「萬人美老師」－郭昱晴擔任主持人。以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力。並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元。內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面。如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元。

programme.title: 布袋小和尚第1集
programme.desc: 說趣事․悟禪理․善能量以生動易懂的品德道理為主旨，精采呈現一部老少皆宜、有趣感人的禪理動畫作品。《布袋小和尚》是中國大陸首部為孩子原創製作的禪意動畫片。《布袋小和尚》以彌勒佛化身的布袋和尚為原型，以奉化雪竇寺為故事發生地，講述一個逍遙自在、無拘無束、笑口常開的大肚彌勒小和尚，和他的夥伴小布袋、吉祥鳥，被委以修建廟宇的重任。在重建廟宇的過程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各種稀奇古怪、啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚運用他的聰明才智和神奇布袋，揚善懲惡，幫助百姓克服困難，用愛心溫暖人間。劇情輕鬆有趣又感人，將中華傳統美德融入其中，使得教育與娛樂相結合，教導少年兒童做好事、說好話、存好心等行為道德，在笑中體會道德的光芒

programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 因為堅持第5集
programme.desc: 在米粒上刻字，在裁縫針上刻字，在頭髮上寫字，毫芒雕刻家陳逢顯在微雕方寸間不斷鑽研，創造無數奇蹟。

programme.title: 島嶼生機第1集
programme.desc: 節目深耕地方，用鏡頭記錄台灣的環境變遷，細膩描繪土地與居民的故事，展現地方媒體的正向力量與人文關懷。

programme.title: 生活快易通第231集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的「萬人美老師」－郭昱晴擔任主持人。以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力。並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元。內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面。如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第4集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 布袋小和尚第1集
programme.desc: 說趣事․悟禪理․善能量以生動易懂的品德道理為主旨，精采呈現一部老少皆宜、有趣感人的禪理動畫作品。《布袋小和尚》是中國大陸首部為孩子原創製作的禪意動畫片。《布袋小和尚》以彌勒佛化身的布袋和尚為原型，以奉化雪竇寺為故事發生地，講述一個逍遙自在、無拘無束、笑口常開的大肚彌勒小和尚，和他的夥伴小布袋、吉祥鳥，被委以修建廟宇的重任。在重建廟宇的過程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各種稀奇古怪、啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚運用他的聰明才智和神奇布袋，揚善懲惡，幫助百姓克服困難，用愛心溫暖人間。劇情輕鬆有趣又感人，將中華傳統美德融入其中，使得教育與娛樂相結合，教導少年兒童做好事、說好話、存好心等行為道德，在笑中體會道德的光芒

programme.title: 生活智多星第1875集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 青春進化論第106集
programme.desc: 在全球一片鼓勵創新創業的風潮下，台灣未來的發展要有競爭力，即需要不斷的創新，讓年輕人有更多機會實現想法及創意，不僅是在協助青年圓夢，更是在打造國家的未來。節目中創業者分享創業甘苦談，創業時面臨的心理掙扎，以及如何克服困難，堅持理想，繼續走下去。【青年創ya家】主持人曾寶儀打破傳統一問一答的制式訪問，以如同家人、朋友間的聊天談心，讓各種你想得到的、想不到的青年創ya家，拋開緊張與包袱，輕鬆自在地分享自己的「青春進化論」。

programme.title: 歡樂家長群第4集
programme.desc: 編劇劉向上日常時間安排相對自由，在家裡負責兒子果寧、女兒果寶的教育陪護，妻子戴靜選擇在薪酬較高的外地公司打拼。劉向上一家因為孩子開學而與朋友、鄰居及其他學生家長成為群友，面對各種突發狀況的新手家長們和鬼馬精靈的孩子們共同迎接教育新課堂、人生新起點的故事。

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第20集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 神奇故事屋第4集
programme.desc: 《神奇故事屋》描述在阿達叔叔的書房裏頭有一個奇幻通道，凡是在這個書房裡讀過的繪本，皆可以透過這個隧道進入到繪本的世界裏頭。故事屋就像時空任意門，帶他們到一個個不同的繪本中旅行。於是，孩子們跟著阿達叔叔進入繪本探險、拜訪台灣各領域的專家、破解歷史的祕密、跟著動物專家上山尋寶……，每一次的冒險都緊張刺激、精采得不得了！

programme.title: 寶島西米樂 守護第374集
programme.desc: 熱鬧的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母親雅芬穿過擁擠的人群，來到生意興隆、美軍也來光顧的「寶島西服店」，尋找失蹤的父親照清。照清曾在這裡當過學徒，和老闆梅樹師是師兄弟，但因故未能出師…。春燕看著梅樹與曉蘭鶼鰈情深地經營「寶島西服店」，這美好的景象讓春燕想起父親曾向自己承諾，未來若跟著師兄梅樹出師後，自己的西服店也會正式掛牌營業，並收女兒春燕當全台第一位西裝女徒弟，將西裝技藝傳承下去

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第21集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.desc: 熱鬧的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母親雅芬穿過擁擠的人群，來到生意興隆、美軍也來光顧的「寶島西服店」，尋找失蹤的父親照清。照清曾在這裡當過學徒，和老闆梅樹師是師兄弟，但因故未能出師…。春燕看著梅樹與曉蘭鶼鰈情深地經營「寶島西服店」，這美好的景象讓春燕想起父親曾向自己承諾，未來若跟著師兄梅樹出師後，自己的西服店也會正式掛牌營業，並收女兒春燕當全台第一位西裝女徒弟，將西裝技藝傳承下去

programme.title: 愛的人生路第25集
programme.desc: 余樹木和老婆元美生了五個女兒，年過四十仍無子嗣，為了傳承香火，元美安排丈夫娶了二房綉蘭。綉蘭不負所望生下天助，原以為家庭從此圓滿和樂，未料元美早逝，大女兒阿雪和二媽綉蘭個性差異，經常為生活瑣事爭執，家庭失和，令天助十分痛苦。 余家這本難念的經，要怎麼轉變為幸福經，共走愛的人生路？

programme.title: 幸福的起點第12集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第44集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 生活地球村第296集
programme.desc: 《生活地球村》是一個以環境、印尼當地智慧以及食物潛力為主題的紀錄片節目。本節目的製作是為了帶領觀眾意識並邀請大家在生活中實踐環保、愛護地球。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第690集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 小主播看天下WOW第166集
programme.desc: 透過每天不同的小單元，培養小朋友創意、幽默、探索、同理、勇氣、夢想、美感、團隊等八大特質，讓小朋友在家也可以探索未知、環遊世界！拓展國際觀，儲備愛物惜地球的小公民知識。

programme.title: 蔬果生活誌第225集
programme.desc: 關於「吃」，該怎麼吃得有智慧、吃出健康和營養呢？ 瞭解臺灣不同時節、氣候的豐富物產，透過農人的智慧和汗水，告訴您食材的生命故事，並且體驗背後的價值與感動。

programme.desc: 京都富商的二女兒今井阿淺(波琉飾)在大阪創立礦碳公司、銀行、生命保險公司等一系列活動，並竭盡全力設立日本第一所女子大學的故事。阿淺的人物原型是被稱爲明治時代女中豪傑的實業家廣岡淺子。這是晨間劇故事首次從幕府末代拉開序幕，引發熱議。同時出演的還有宮崎葵、寺島忍、玉木宏等演員。

programme.title: 映照人生第527集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2121集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子第6季:第431集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活為藍本的故事，其中一事一物均充滿著1970年代的懷舊氣息。故事發生的舞台是日本靜岡縣清水市，那是一個不折不扣的美麗港都，是個交通便利、漁產豐富、又與富士山為鄰的好地方。故事圍繞著小丸子以及其家人和同學展開，有關於親情、友誼等，或是一些生活小事，但當中有笑有淚，令人回想起童年的稚氣。

programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第171集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 霹靂俠影之轟霆劍海錄第68集
programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑后，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 天子傳奇第27集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－紂王，好大喜功，征戰連連，百姓為其榷稅徵租，貧乏窮困，哀聲載道，民心漸失。一日在平魔的慶功宴時，代表大商國運的鎮國龍龜猝亡，適時西現紫氣，紂王視為必是西出妖孽，足以禍國，便遣妖帥調領大軍征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬發，出世時天空出現異象，百姓皆稱其為未來聖主。姬昌算易知悉姬發有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺險施行九鼎奇法，卻因妖帥與九大護衛殺入，反成九五至尊之數。大祭司見弄巧成拙，建請紂王宣召姬發上京面聖，藉機要將姬發煉製靈人，代替護國祥物，紂王為保王命，想盡辦法不擇手段，導致天怒人怨，因此種下亡國敗運的禍根。 姬發面聖路上，災劫連連，有飄渺城之困，卻因禍得福習得「渾天寶

programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑后，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 包青天第122集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 獨立特派員第978集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視台的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 真情部落格第782集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 福氣人生第766集
programme.desc: 要擁有福氣人生，可以透過聆聽牧師們以台語分享聖經的真理，讓你領受天國滿滿的福氣與祝福。這些牧師們將以深入淺出的方式解釋聖經，將其應用於當代生活，讓你明白神的心意和計劃。通過聆聽台語講道，你可以更深入地理解聖經的教導，並在日常生活中實踐。這些講道將提供實際的指引和智慧，幫助你在家庭、工作、人際關係等各個領域經歷神的福氣。聆聽這樣的講道，你將能夠領悟到屬天的價值觀和生活方式，學習依靠聖靈的帶領，活出基督徒的身份和見證。這將使你能夠更深入地體驗神的愛和恩典，並將其傳遞給他人。

programme.title: 恩典365第1609集

programme.desc: 這個節目是一個多面向的家庭訪談節目，探討了婚姻、戀愛、親子、工作、銀髮生活等多個議題。我們的目標是在輕鬆的氣氛中引導觀眾深入了解問題的核心，並找到解決方案。

programme.title: 機智青年生活第21集
programme.desc: 聚焦青年生活與職場挑戰，探討現代青年面臨的各種議題。 透過訪談與故事分享，展現青年正向成長與自我突破。 結合實用資訊與勵志元素，鼓勵青年積極面對人生挑戰。

programme.title: 遇見祝福第1集
programme.desc: 福音短片，每天三分鐘，能夠重新激發您的力量並蒙受祝福！這些短片以生活化的例證，幫助朋友們更深入地認識耶穌！讓您在忙碌的生活中，用短短三分鐘，與福音相連，並與耶穌建立更親密的關係！

programme.title: 真情部落格第431集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.desc: 一起唱出具有渲染力的文化音符，「族語童謠裡述說的是我們的根」，全新型態的兒童少年節目《senay345》，將透過活潑創新的兒童音樂節目形式，提供不同族群孩童一個享受展演的舞台。每一集會邀請二位孩童，在節目中演唱族語歌曲，聽著小朋友說著族語故事，透過童趣的自然對話與互動激發創作力和表達能力，一起感受到純粹快樂自然的沉浸在族語世界裡。

programme.desc: 原視晚安報新聞，提供最新、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題，讓觀眾在午後休息時，獲得及時且可靠的資訊，了解當日發生的重要事件和動態。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第314集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 【客家尋味劇場】台北歌手第6集
programme.desc: 男高音、小說家和劇作家於一身，戰後，甚至提起武器參與反抗行動，36歲的呂赫若正值大展風華才氣之際，卻不幸死於非命，作為台灣文學史上的風雲人物，客家電視台將重新打造呂赫若的生平與其作品改編為連續劇，嘗試探索才子傳奇的一生。

programme.title: 村民大會-過家尞聊正事第117集
programme.desc: 打造一台行動雜貨店，駛入客庄大街小巷，歡迎鄉親一起來喝茶聊天，暢談地方議題，大人小孩都來「過家尞聊正事」，關心客庄大小事！

programme.title: 福氣來了第78集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 後生大聲公第87集
programme.desc: 節目邀請18~25歲的客家年輕人，聊聊對客家、對教育、對媒體、對社會議題的看法。

programme.title: 日頭下‧月光光第108集
programme.desc: 此齣為與生活資訊結合的客家戲劇，客語口說藝術的劇場，其中包含了相聲竹板快書、以及說文解字，用活潑逗趣的表演方式，來傳達客家語言，敬請觀眾鎖定收看！

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第307集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面了解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第258集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 奧林p客第1636集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.title: 恐龍大牧場 III第4集
programme.desc: 在這片自然優美、作物豐富的大西部土地上，卡西迪家族與恐龍夥伴們共同經營著牧場，過著既忙碌又充滿驚喜的生活。無論是訓練恐龍、追查野生迅猛龍的足跡，還是保護珍貴的月光百合花，孩子們與恐龍總能在挑戰中成長，在合作中找到解答。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1162集

programme.title: 一家之煮第477集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾了解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第7集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(大埔腔)第20集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: 懂吃懂吃來煮食第18集
programme.desc: 踏上歡愉的旅程，烹煮出暖心的滋味！

programme.title: 當晝新聞第315集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客庄的人文風情和自然景觀。這套設備擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客庄所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第21集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.desc: 我們邀請了許多專業的音樂家和創作者擔任所長，他們將帶給您最好的音樂和創作心情。這個節目的目的是讓您在睡前能夠享受美妙的歌聲，讓一整天的緊繃情緒都能夠釋放出來。此外，我們還會不時地分享一些有關音樂的小知識，讓您對音樂有更深入的了解。

programme.desc: 節目場景復刻了早期客莊鄰里間最熱鬧、也最能聊天的雜貨店前空地。在這裡，沒有刻板的說教，只有銀髮長輩與主持人，像在大樹下乘涼般，自在地聊生活、聊煩惱，也聊那些平常說不出口的心事。
